description: Editorial research-area classification matching the ten problem directories. Each stable problem ID has one primary part.

parts.name: Geometry and Convex Geometry
parts.label: 几何与凸几何
parts.scope: Convex bodies, geometric inequalities, coverings, simplices, triangulations, and discrete geometry.

parts.name: Combinatorics and Graph Theory
parts.label: 组合数学与图论
parts.scope: Graph parameters, extremal and spectral graph theory, combinatorial convexity, and random discrete structures.

parts.name: Continuous Optimization and Variational Analysis
parts.label: 连续优化与变分分析
parts.scope: First-order and quasi-Newton methods, constrained and polynomial optimization, variational analysis, monotone operators, and stochastic and distributed optimization.

parts.name: Discrete and Combinatorial Optimization
parts.label: 离散与组合优化
parts.scope: Integer programming, polyhedra, matching, matroids, scheduling, routing, and approximation algorithms.

parts.name: Numerical Analysis and Algebraic Computation
parts.label: 数值分析与代数计算
parts.scope: Numerical linear algebra, rounding error and stability, structured matrix computation, and polynomial and semialgebraic computation.

parts.name: Probability and Stochastic Models
parts.label: 概率与随机模型
parts.scope: Limit theorems, stochastic processes, diffusions, queueing, risk measures, and stochastic coupling and transport.

parts.name: Optimal Control and Sequential Decision-Making
parts.label: 最优控制与序贯决策
parts.scope: MDPs, dynamic programming, stochastic and robust control, optimal stopping, policy iteration, and learning in controlled systems.

parts.name: Game Theory and Mathematical Economics
parts.label: 博弈论与数理经济学
parts.scope: Equilibria, static and dynamic games, markets, auctions, mechanism design, fair division, and social choice.

parts.name: Online Algorithms and Online Learning
parts.label: 在线算法与在线学习
parts.scope: Online selection and allocation, prophet inequalities, secretary problems, competitive analysis, and regret bounds.

parts.name: Statistical Learning and Inference
parts.label: 统计学习与推断
parts.scope: Statistical estimation, generalization, structured recovery, and guarantees for generative models and sampling.
